summary: Radiant Logistics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of David Buss as Senior Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, effective August 31, 2026, under Item 5.02. The filing details his employment agreement with an annual base salary of $250,000, incentive compensation eligibility, and severance provisions of six months for death/disability or termination without cause, or twelve months following a change of control with qualifying termination. This is a routine executive appointment, not a special situation such as a forced departure or strategic event. No transaction, tender, or restructuring is implicated. The event is an ordinary management addition; for investors, watch for operational execution under new COO rather than deal-related catalysts.
